questions.question: A student ranks 46th from the left and 64th from the right. How many students are there?
questions.explanation: Add the left and right ranks and subtract one for the person counted twice: 46+64−1 = 109.

questions.question: A student ranks 39th from the left and 27th from the right. How many students are there?
questions.explanation: Add the left and right ranks and subtract one for the person counted twice: 39+27−1 = 65.

questions.question: A student ranks 8th from the left and 29th from the right. How many students are there?
questions.explanation: Add the left and right ranks and subtract one for the person counted twice: 8+29−1 = 36.
